stories.title: Ex GF Ki Panty Utaar Ke Chut Chatne Wali Kahani
stories.excerpt: College ki purani premika Deepa, 38 saal ki widow, akele pan mein tadap rahi thi. Jab uska ex boyfriend Pallab Italy se laut ke usse milne aaya, to 25 saal purani yaadein phir se jaag uthi.

stories.title: Bahu Ki Pehli Mahine Mein Sasur Aur Devar Ne Gaand-Chut Dono Faad Di
stories.excerpt: Nayi-naveli bahu Priya ki shaadi ke 18 din baad hi pati Dubai chala gaya. Uske baad saas Sunita ke order pe sasur Vikram aur devar Rohit ne roz uski gaand aur chut dono force se chodi. Har raat teenon milke uska body use karte the. Yeh ek pure force wali, dirty Indian joint-family chudai story hai.
